1: # BK7258 OpenVela UART0 Mailbox V2完整收发移植方案
2: 
3: ## 1. 文档目标和结论
4: 
5: 本文是`BK7258_OPENVELA_AP_PORTING_PLAN.md`中UART0和Mailbox V2章节的可实施细化方案。依据当前工作区的OpenVela AP实现、`bk_avdk_smp` AP/CP源码、比赛仓CP覆盖文件、原厂网页文档和生成的内存布局，目标是在不占用CPU1物理UART1、不改变CP物理UART0下载和启动行为的前提下，实现：
6: 
7: ```text
8: AP/OpenVela输出
9:   NuttX console/syslog/NSH stdout
10:     -> AP MB_UART0 TX
11:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x19
12:     -> CP MB_UART0 RX
13:     -> CP shell TX queue
14:     -> CP UART0/GPIO11/CH340/PC
15: 
16: PC输入
17:   PC/CH340/UART0 RX/GPIO10
18:     -> CP shell UART RX owner
19:     -> 显式AP console输入模式
20:     -> CP MB_UART0 TX
21:     -> Mailbox V2 logical channel 0x49
22:     -> AP MB_UART0 RX
23:     -> NuttX serial upper-half
24:     -> /dev/console/NSH stdin
25: ```
26: 
27: 最终结论：
28: 
29: - `MB_UART0`本身是全双工、带软件RTS/CTS流控的虚拟UART，不是单向日志命令。
30: - AP发送使用logical channel `0x19`，CP发送使用logical channel `0x49`；两者都是同一个MB_UART0的本端发送编号。
31: - 每个Mailbox V2 envelope只携带16字节message的地址和长度；DATA message再携带固定128字节交换区的地址和有效长度。
32: - 当前本地AP实现只完成AP到CP的输出；收到CP DATA后固定返回成功但不复制数据。当前CP覆盖也只读取AP输出，没有PC到AP输入路径。
33: - 完整移植必须同时修改OpenVela AP和Armino CP。只补AP RX或只调用CP `bk_mb_uart_write()`都不能形成完整控制台。
34: - 正式实现保持原厂16字节message、DATA/STATE和RTS/CTS线协议兼容，但必须修复本地实现的buffer所有权、ACK队列、reset、RX校验和NuttX serial接入问题；不得照搬原厂未初始化尾字节、未校验payload指针和失败后静默丢包等缺陷。
35: 
36: ## 2. 基线、范围和非目标
37: 
38: ### 2.1 开发和交付目录
39: 
40: - OpenVela AP开发目录：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/`。
41: - OpenVela board配置：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/`。
42: - CP可复现覆盖的权威副本：`contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/`。
43: - CP实际构建树：`bk_avdk_smp/`。CP改动必须先落权威副本，再按该目录`README.md`同步到构建树并逐字节检查。
44: - `bk_idk`、`bk_solution_ai`、`vendor_beken`和网页文档仅作为参考，不是BK7258 OpenVela正式开发目录。
45: 
46: ### 2.2 本轮范围
47: 
48: - Mailbox V2 CPU1 channel 1物理收发、IRQ79、FIFO drain和错误恢复。
49: - CPU1到CPU0 logical channel复用调度，至少不破坏HW_CTRL、PWC和UART0。
50: - AP侧MB_UART0 DATA/STATE、双向ring、流控、ACK和NuttX serial lower-half。
51: - CP侧MB_UART0接收输出和UART0输入转发。
52: - CP CLI与AP NSH对唯一UART0输入的显式所有权切换。
53: - 冷启动、AP重启、CP重启、Mailbox reset和压力验收。
54: 
55: ### 2.3 非目标
56: 
57: - 不启用CPU1物理UART1，不切换GPIO0/1，不要求第二个USB-TTL。
58: - 不用`MB_CHNL_LOG`的`MB_CMD_USER_INPUT`替代逐字节TTY。该协议只能转发完整Armino CLI命令，不具备NSH readline、退格和Ctrl-C语义。
59: - 不修改bootloader下载串口协议。AP console接管只能发生在CP运行期，并且必须在AP ready以后。
60: - 不承诺在Mailbox IRQ和调度器可用前输出启动日志。panic时若中断关闭，MB_UART也不能工作；原厂文档同样明确其不是无中断polling UART。
61: - 第一版不启用MB_UART CRC8。原厂当前配置下CRC恒为0；单边启用会不兼容。保留字段并校验其为0，后续只能在AP/CP同时升级后启用。
62: 
63: ## 3. 已确认的协议事实
64: 
65: ### 3.1 CPU和logical channel编码
66: 
67: logical channel为8位：
68: 
69: ```text
70: bit[7:6] destination CPU
71: bit[5:4] source CPU
72: bit[3:0] logical channel index
73: ```
74: 
75: CPU0/CP为0，CPU1/AP为1。UART0的组内index为9，因此：
76: 
77: | 本端 | 方向 | 发送channel | 接收报文中的channel |
78: | --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
79: | AP/OpenVela | CPU1 -> CPU0 | `0x19` | `0x49` |
80: | CP/Armino | CPU0 -> CPU1 | `0x49` | `0x19` |
81: 
82: 参考：
83: 
84: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:32-44,53,77-96`
85: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:29-41,49,64-83`
86: 
87: 不得将`0x19`和`0x49`理解为两个独立UART，也不得用IPC `0x10`、PWC `0x12/0x42`或`MB_CHNL_LOG`承载UART字节流。
88: 
89: ### 3.2 Mailbox V2 envelope
90: 
91: MBOX0硬件FIFO中的两个data word是：
92: 
93: | FIFO word | 含义 |
94: | --- | --- |
95: | `data[0]` | 发送端稳定16字节message的32位地址 |
96: | `data[1]` | 固定为16 |
97: 
98: 接收端根据硬件SID确认源CPU，再复制16字节message。AP接收的message地址来自CP拥有的稳定SRAM，CP接收的地址来自AP拥有的稳定SRAM。不能让FIFO引用栈变量，也不能在对端复制前复用或改写该slot。
99: 
100: ### 3.3 16字节message header
101: 
102: word0布局固定如下：
103: 
104: ```text
105: bit[7:0]   cmd
106: bit[11:8]  state
107: bit[15:12] ctrl
108: bit[23:16] tx_seq
109: bit[31:24] logical_chnl
110: ```
111: 
112: `ctrl`定义：
113: 
114: | 位 | 名称 | 语义 |
115: | ---: | --- | --- |
116: | 0 | `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX` | 1表示transport ACK，0表示command |
117: | 1 | `CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX` | 无ACK同步发送；正式UART普通路径不使用 |
118: | 2 | `CHNL_CTRL_RESET` | transport重同步 |
119: 
120: `state bit0`为`CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL`。ACK必须至少匹配`source/destination + logical_chnl + tx_seq + cmd`，不匹配的ACK只能计为stale/bad ACK，不能释放当前事务。
121: 
122: ### 3.4 MB_UART message布局
123: 
124: 协议运行于ARM32 little-endian。不得在OpenVela实现中继续依赖编译器bitfield，使用显式mask/shift和定宽字段。
125: 
126: DATA/STATE command为16字节：
127: 
128: | offset | 大小 | 字段 |
129: | ---: | ---: | --- |
130: | 0 | 1 | `cmd`：DATA=0，STATE=1 |
131: | 1 | 1 | state/ctrl，发送command时初始为0 |
132: | 2 | 1 | transport sequence |
133: | 3 | 1 | logical channel |
134: | 4 | 4 | DATA交换buffer地址；STATE为0 |
135: | 8 | 2 | DATA有效长度1..128；STATE为0 |
136: | 10 | 1 | bit0=`uart_rts`，其余必须0 |
137: | 11 | 1 | `crc8`，当前兼容值为0 |
138: | 12 | 4 | 保留，必须清0 |
139: 
140: ACK为同一个16字节slot的响应语义：
141: 
142: | offset | 含义 |
143: | ---: | --- |
144: | 0..3 | 原cmd、state，加ACK ctrl、sequence和channel |
145: | 4 bit0 | 接收端当前`uart_rts` |
146: | 4 bit1 | `uart_tx_fail`，本DATA整包未接收 |
147: | 4 bit7:2 | 0 |
148: | 5..15 | 0 |
149: 
150: 所有command和ACK结构在构造前必须`memset(..., 0, 16)`，避免原厂实现中offset 12..15栈残留和ACK尾部旧数据泄漏。这是AP/CP同步升级后的正式ABI要求：当前原厂CP command确实可能带非零栈残留，因此CP清零修复必须先于AP启用严格保留字段拒绝策略，不能只升级AP。
151: 
152: ### 3.5 UART0交换区和所有权
153: 
154: 项目RAM布局固定预留：
155: 
156: ```text
157: SWAP = 0x2809f800..0x2809ffff, size 0x800
158: ```
159: 
160: 来自：
161: 
162: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:6-10`
163: - 生成的`ram_regions.h`中`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR=0x2809f800`、`CONFIG_SWAP_SIZE=0x800`
164: 
165: 每个支持共享payload的logical channel占`0x200`字节，顺序为HW_CTRL、LOG、UART0、UART1。每个方向/CPU slot为128字节。当前CPU0/CPU1 UART0精确映射为：
166: 
167: | 地址 | owner/方向 | AP视角 |
168: | --- | --- | --- |
169: | `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f` | CP host_tx[CPU1] | AP RX payload，只读后复制 |
170: | `0x2809fc80..0x2809fcff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
171: | `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f` | AP host_rx[CPU1] | AP TX payload，ACK前保持不变 |
172: | `0x2809fd80..0x2809fdff` | CPU2预留 | AP不得使用 |
173: 
174: OpenVela linker必须新增独立`SWAP` memory region并标记为`NOLOAD`。当前构建顺序是先构建OpenVela、后构建SMP，OpenVela不能读取尚未生成的CP `ram_regions.h`；单一来源固定为比赛仓已提交的`external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`。增加预构建生成/校验脚本，由该CSV同时生成或核对OpenVela board header和linker fragment；最终SMP构建后再与Armino生成的`CONFIG_SWAP_ADDR/SIZE`自动比较。不能维护两套无校验硬编码。
175: 
176: 不能把SWAP并入AP heap，不能由AP启动代码清零整个SWAP，也不能在AP `.bss`另建一个“看起来等价”的交换buffer。
177: 
178: 首版在`bk7258_start.c`增加显式共享MPU region，并先读取MPU `TYPE.DREGION`确认region预算：CP普通RAM中的envelope窗口为shareable、non-cacheable、RO/XN；CP拥有的UART0 RX payload `0x2809fc00..0x2809fc7f`为RO/XN；AP拥有的UART0 TX payload `0x2809fd00..0x2809fd7f`为RW/XN。当前MPU使用`PRIVDEFENA`，未覆盖地址对privileged内核仍可访问，因此CPU2预留slot只能由MB_UART软件白名单/API禁止访问，不能声称由MPU隔离。
179: 
180: 若硬件region数不足以按128字节拆分，才允许将整个SWAP设为RW/XN，但必须记录这是硬件粒度降级并继续以软件白名单强制方向所有权，不能把CP普通RAM扩大为RW。若未来要求硬件阻止访问预留slot，必须关闭`PRIVDEFENA`并完整映射所有必要内存，这不属于本轮UART移植。
181: 
182: 若后续启用D-cache，所有ownership交接统一由共享内存API执行：发布前clean + DMB，读取前invalidate + DMB，ACK后才复用；cache line为32字节，操作必须向外对齐且不能误刷相邻owner数据。
183: 
184: ## 4. 当前实现差距
185: 
186: ### 4.1 AP侧
187: 
188: 当前`bk7258_mailbox_channel.c`具备基础`0x19/0x49`分派、AP TX ring和transport ACK匹配，但存在以下交付阻断项：
189: 
190: 1. `MB_CHNL_UART0_RX`只检查DATA/STATE后固定返回`uart_rts=0, uart_tx_fail=0`，不校验、不复制CP payload，输入被静默丢弃。
191: 2. 没有MB_UART RX ring、RTS高低水位、STATE发送和对端RTS/CTS门控。
192: 3. AP TX payload使用普通AP `.bss`中的`g_uart_xchg`，没有复用原厂SWAP地址和跨核固定所有权。
193: 4. 单个`g_ack_message`在FIFO full时可被下一条RX覆盖。
194: 5. ACK超时后清busy并原地改sequence重发同一buffer，会造成旧FIFO envelope观察到新内容、重复日志和非幂等PWC重复执行。
195: 6. reset只清physical busy，没有终止/失败完成active transaction、修复UART inflight或向CP重新同步。
196: 7. 初始化在注册IRQ后直接丢弃RX FIFO，已到达command得不到ACK，可能令CP永久busy。
197: 8. envelope仅白名单CP普通RAM，payload还需要独立SWAP精确白名单。
198: 9. logical channel和MB_UART混在一个文件，无法清晰复用和测试状态机。
199: 10. 仅`up_irq_save()`适用于当前单核AP；进入NuttX SMP后不能阻止CPU2并发。
200: 
201: 当前`bk7258_serial.c`的`receive()`固定返回-1、`rxavailable()`固定false、`rxint()`为空，因而`read()`、`poll(POLLIN)`和NSH均无输入。设备同时冒充硬件UART1并注册`/dev/ttyS1`，Kconfig/defconfig也错误命名为UART1。
202: 
203: 当前`bk7258_syslog.c`忽略实际写入结果并总是返回全部长度，单次`size_t`还隐式截断为`uint16_t`；`force`与普通路径相同，不能提供panic flush保证。
204: 
205: ### 4.2 CP侧
206: 
207: 当前CP覆盖`cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c`只完成：
208: 
209: ```text
210: bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0) -> 按行聚合 -> 添加"ap0: " -> shell_log_raw_data()
211: ```
212: 
213: 它没有`bk_mb_uart_write(MB_UART0, ...)`，也没有从物理UART0 RX到MB_UART0 TX的路由。50 ms半行刷新和每行前缀适合日志，不适合作为NSH raw terminal：prompt会延迟，echo和ANSI序列会被改写。
214: 
215: 不能在`driver.c`另外注册UART0 RX ISR，因为CP shell已经通过`shell_uart_open()`占用UART driver唯一RX callback；后注册会覆盖CP shell。输入路由必须在现有shell UART owner内部或其读取后的`rx_ind_process()`入口完成。
216:

218:

259: 
260: ## 6. AP Mailbox V2 transport设计
261: 
262: ### 6.1 物理层
263: 
264: CPU1只配置自己拥有的channel 1：FIFO start=2、length=3，接收IRQ source 63映射到NuttX IRQ79。物理层初始化必须在`up_initialize()`可使用NuttX IRQ API后、board late逻辑服务前完成。
265: 
266: ISR固定执行：
267: 
268: 1. 读取并累计`wrerr/rderr/wrfull`等W1C错误状态。
269: 2. 循环读取FIFO直到empty，不能每次中断只取一个。
270: 3. 校验SID为CPU0、length为16、地址4字节对齐、`address + 16`无溢出且位于CP RAM `0x28064000..0x2809f6ff`。当前CP `mbox0_adapter.c`的envelope slot是可随链接变化的普通`.bss mailbox_buff`，并没有固定地址ABI或32字节对齐，AP不能写死更小窗口。
271: 4. 立即复制到AP-owned RX descriptor queue，随后上层处理；不能长期持有CP message指针。
272: 5. 若RX descriptor queue或ACK资源不足，停止继续drain并保留中断，不能读出后无ACK丢弃。
273: 
274: 初始化时不再盲目drain。应先安装logical callback和RX/ACK资源，再处理已有FIFO。无法识别的有效command也必须返回`COM_FAIL` ACK。
275: 
276: ### 6.2 稳定transaction slot
277: 
278: 每个CPU0物理方向同时只允许一个command in-flight，以兼容原厂physical BUSY模型。实现至少准备：
279: 
280: - 每个logical channel一个16字节pending command副本。
281: - 一个独立16字节active slot；发送后直到ACK/reset完成不可修改。
282: - 至少3个AP-owned ACK slots和一个ACK FIFO，容量不小于硬件RX FIFO深度。
283: - AP新建的active/ACK message slot按32字节对齐并位于AP RAM白名单；接收CP envelope只要求原厂ABI的4字节对齐和CP RAM范围。payload SWAP另行精确校验。
284: 
285: slot释放事件必须明确，因为硬件FIFO保存的是地址而不是16字节值：
286: 
287: - command正常收到匹配ACK后可释放。
288: - command timeout后转为quarantine；发送RESET不释放它。RESET和随后STATE使用各自独立稳定slot。只有STATE收到成功ACK，利用同一AP->CP FIFO顺序证明旧command、RESET和STATE都已被复制后，才一起释放旧command和RESET slot。STATE失败时保持quarantine，直到MBOX硬件重新初始化，不能因进入DOWN就复用。
289: - ACK slot不能以“收到对端下一条command”为释放证据，因为对端timeout后可能绕过旧ACK继续发送。只有本端随后一个同方向、需要ACK的普通事务收到成功ACK，才能证明排在它之前的本端ACK envelope已经被对端复制。
290: - ACK pool达到高水位（建议已占用2/3）时，transport必须立即在所有待发ACK之后调度一个独立稳定slot的STATE probe。probe收到成功ACK后，按本端FIFO发送顺序批量释放排在它之前的ACK slots；probe失败则进入DOWN并保持这些slot quarantine。不能依赖heartbeat或应用数据未来恰好出现。
291: - RESET和SYNC都没有自己的ACK。RESET由紧随其后的成功STATE释放；通用SYNC使用独立slot，并在下一个同方向普通事务成功完成后释放。专用slot尚未释放时再次调用同类旁路发送返回`-EBUSY`，不得有限轮转后覆盖。
292: - ACK在DOWN、ABORTING、PROBING和QUIESCING状态下仍是最高发送优先级；状态变化不能免除已经接收的对端command所需ACK。
293: 
294: CP `mbox0_adapter.c`也按相同原则分别管理command、ACK、RESET和SYNC slot，禁止现有“每次发送无条件轮转两个slot”的做法。
295: 
296: 调度优先级保持原厂“logical index越小优先级越高”：HW_CTRL、PWC优先于UART0，避免日志压力阻塞heartbeat和电源命令。ACK永远高于新command。
297: 
298: ### 6.3 ACK和超时
299: 
300: 收到ACK后完整检查：
301: 
302: ```text
303: SID == CPU0
304: ACK_BOX == 1
305: logical_channel == active.channel
306: tx_seq == active.seq
307: cmd == active.cmd
308: RESET/state/reserved组合合法
309: ```
310: 
311: 匹配成功后才释放active slot并调用logical completion。UART completion再根据`COM_FAIL`和`uart_tx_fail`决定成功或失败。
312: 
313: 超时不得直接修改active buffer并重发。第一版策略：
314: 
315: 1. 200 ms无ACK，标记当前transaction失败并保留错误快照。
316: 2. 停止所有普通新TX，向CPU0发送原厂兼容RESET abort通知；RESET使用独立稳定slot。
317: 3. RESET是`ACK_BOX|RESET`单向通知，CP空闲时会忽略，不返回RESET ACK。AP发送成功后进入PROBING，并用独立slot发送后续MB_UART STATE；不能等待不存在的RESET ACK，也不能复用被abort事务的slot。
318: 4. abort发出或收到peer reset后，所有pending非幂等PWC请求以`-ECONNRESET`完成，不自动重放。
319: 5. UART chunk可保留在本地TX ring，重新交换STATE后最多重发一次；日志允许重复风险时也必须通过计数可见。建议默认不自动重发已经可能被对端消费但ACK丢失的chunk，而是丢弃该chunk并累计`tx_unknown`，避免终端出现重复字符。
320: 6. RESET envelope发送失败或后续STATE仍无ACK则link进入DOWN，heartbeat/ready逻辑可检测并执行既定降级或复位策略。
321: 
322: 8位sequence在每次新transaction递增，0可自然出现；本地abort后建立新的软件epoch。不能仅靠wire sequence解决跨reset的极晚ACK。链路状态统一为`DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING`：ABORTING不发新的普通command，PROBING只发STATE普通command，但所有状态始终优先发送已欠的ACK。
323: 
324: 只有STATE ACK同时满足channel/sequence/cmd匹配、`COM_FAIL==0`、`uart_tx_fail==0`、保留字段合法并成功取得peer RTS时，才能从PROBING进入READY。匹配但带`COM_FAIL`的ACK表示CP尚未open MB_UART0，应在有界退避后继续探测，达到总超时后进入DOWN。
325: 
326: ### 6.4 reset方向
327: 
328: AP transport初始化完成后主动向CP发送一次原厂RESET abort通知，作用是让CP结束可能指向上一个AP boot的in-flight transaction。它不是双向握手：AP不等待响应，而是随后发送STATE探测。收到CP RESET时：
329: 
330: - 对当前active事务生成`-ECONNRESET` completion，但其slot转入quarantine而不复用。反方向收到peer RESET不能证明本端目标FIFO中的旧envelope已经被复制。
331: - 终止本端active/pending outgoing事务并清理其physical busy和peer RTS已知状态；不得清理已经接收且尚未发送的ACK queue。
332: - 保留尚未提交的本地UART TX ring，丢弃不完整AP RX chunk。
333: - 不返回RESET ACK；按原厂语义完成本端abort，再由MB_UART STATE/ACK恢复流控。
334: 
335: CP侧原厂channel层已有处理AP reset并将旧事务以`COM_FAIL`完成的基础逻辑；CP空闲时会直接忽略RESET。上板前需验证当前CP分支未被其他补丁破坏。
336: 
337: quarantine slot只能由后续同方向STATE成功ACK释放，或由明确清空AP->CP目标channel/FIFO的CP侧重初始化、全系统复位释放。AP只重初始化自己的channel 1、IRQ或RX FIFO不能证明CPU0目标FIFO中的旧地址已消失，不得作为释放条件。
338: 
339: ## 7. AP MB_UART0设计
340: 
341: ### 7.1 控制块
342: 
343: AP MB_UART0至少维护：
344: 
345: - `tx_ring`：建议4096或8192字节，用于console/syslog burst，单producer假设不可成立，写入需NuttX spinlock保护。
346: - `rx_ring`：257字节，实际容量256，与原厂语义一致。
347: - 固定AP TX SWAP地址`0x2809fd00`，固定AP RX SWAP地址`0x2809fc00`。
348: - `tx_inflight_len`、`tx_command`、`tx_busy`和`state_pending`。
349: - `local_rts`：AP RX流控；0允许CP发送，1暂停。
350: - `peer_rts`：来自CP command/ACK；0允许AP发送，1暂停。
351: - `rx_irq_enabled`：NuttX serial upper-half当前是否允许接收。
352: - link状态：DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING。
353: - 分项统计：write/drop、DATA/STATE、overflow、bad pointer/length/CRC、remote fail、ACK timeout、reset、high watermark持续时间。
354: 
355: ### 7.2 AP发送
356: 
357: `write()`只把实际可容纳的字节数写入TX ring并返回该字节数，不返回“部分写入后-ENOSPC”这种不可恢复语义。NuttX serial `send()`每次一个字符，syslog bulk write则循环分片并准确报告短写。
358: 
359: 发送条件：link READY、无MB_UART transaction in-flight、`peer_rts==0`、TX ring非空。每次最多取128字节复制到`0x2809fd00`，构造DATA：
360: 
361: ```text
362: cmd_buff     = 0x2809fd00
363: cmd_data_len = min(tx_count, 128)
364: uart_rts     = local_rts
365: crc8         = 0
366: reserved     = 0
367: ```
368: 
369: 与当前本地代码不同，TX ring读指针在成功ACK后才推进。收到`COM_FAIL`或`uart_tx_fail`时不推进；先记录失败并按reset策略处理，避免原厂“提交logical write即消费，ACK失败静默丢失”的缺陷。
370: 
371: 若没有数据但`local_rts`发生变化，发送STATE。DATA ACK本身已携带最新RTS，因此在DATA处理中可合并待发STATE，但不能丢掉最终状态变化。
372: 
373: ### 7.3 AP接收
374: 
375: 收到channel `0x49` command后先验证header，再处理：
376: 
377: DATA必须同时满足：
378: 
379: - `cmd_buff == 0x2809fc00`，不接受“位于SWAP任意位置”或普通CP RAM中的任意指针。
380: - `1 <= cmd_data_len <= 128`，地址加法无溢出。
381: - `crc8 == 0`且保留位为0。
382: - 当前link允许接收。
383: 
384: 接收前执行共享内存acquire/cache invalidate。只有RX ring剩余空间大于等于整包长度时才整包复制；否则整包不复制，设置sticky overflow并在ACK中置`uart_tx_fail=1`。绝不部分接收后报告失败，否则发送端无法确定消费边界。
385: 
386: 无论DATA还是STATE，都更新`peer_rts=command.uart_rts`。响应ACK包含最新`local_rts`。成功DATA复制后触发NuttX RX处理；ISR内不运行NSH、不格式化日志。
387: 
388: ### 7.4 RTS/CTS水位
389: 
390: 保持原厂兼容阈值：
391: 
392: - RX ring总数组257字节、容量256。
393: - 剩余空间`<=128`时设置`local_rts=1`，确保已经在途的一个最大128字节chunk仍有明确处理结果。
394: - 应用读取后，occupancy低于102字节时设置`local_rts=0`并发送STATE，提供滞回避免状态抖动。
395: - `peer_rts=1`时AP禁止新DATA，但仍允许必要的ACK、RESET和本端STATE。
396: 
397: 由于NuttX还有一层`uart_dev_s.recv` ring，MB_UART RX ring的RTS必须根据“MB_UART ring可用空间”管理；`uart_recvchars()`应及时搬运到NuttX ring。新的`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE` Kconfig必须`select OTHER_UART_SERIALDRIVER`、`select OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`select SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL`，不能只在defconfig手写隐藏symbol；`OTHER_SERIAL_CONSOLE`再通过NuttX console choice选择`SERIAL_CONSOLE`。
398: 
399: 第一版同时启用`SERIAL_IFLOWCONTROL_WATERMARKS`，upper/lower watermark固定为75%/25%。NuttX upper-half到达75%时停止继续搬运并保持/拉高MB_UART RTS；低于25%后重新调用搬运并释放RTS。若不启watermark选项，NuttX只会在full/empty回调，不能声称具备本文的高低水位行为。
400: 
401: ### 7.5 NuttX serial接入
402: 
403: 正式设备不再冒充物理UART1：
404: 
405: - 注册`/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`到同一个Mailbox UART device。
406: - 删除`CONFIG_UART1_SERIALDRIVER`、`CONFIG_UART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE`和`BK7258_AP_UART1`误导配置。
407: - 新增板级`BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE`选择，并让NuttX console宏映射到该虚拟设备。
408: - 不执行任何UART1 clock、pinmux或GPIO0/1配置。
409: 
410: `uart_ops_s`实现：
411: 
412: | op | 行为 |
413: | --- | --- |
414: | `setup/attach` | 确认MB_UART已注册callback，不能重复初始化physical mailbox |
415: | `shutdown/detach` | 普通console关闭不销毁全局heartbeat共用transport |
416: | `receive` | 从MB_UART RX ring弹出1字节，status返回overflow/parity sticky快照 |
417: | `rxavailable` | 查询MB_UART RX ring非空 |
418: | `rxint` | 保存enable；enable时投递RX worker或调用受控`uart_recvchars()` |
419: | `send` | 写一个字节到MB_UART TX ring；只在`txready`为true时由upper-half调用 |
420: | `txint` | enable时调用`uart_xmitchars()`，ACK/CTS恢复后再次kick |
421: | `txready` | link ready、TX ring有空间；不要求物理channel当前idle |
422: | `txempty` | NuttX xmit ring、MB_UART TX ring和active DATA都为空 |
423: | `rxflowcontrol` | upper-half高水位时拉高local RTS，恢复时拉低并kick RX |
424: 
425: Mailbox ISR只将DATA复制到MB_UART RX ring并post一个高优先级worker/semaphore。worker调用`uart_recvchars()`，避免在硬件Mailbox ISR里进入完整TTY路径。TX ACK或peer RTS从1变0时，同样由worker调用`uart_xmitchars()`。
426: 
427: ### 7.6 syslog和early putc
428: 
429: - transport ready前允许写入一个小型有界early TX ring；满后丢弃并计数，不阻塞启动。
430: - transport ready后由MB_UART worker排空early数据。
431: - bulk syslog按`size_t`循环，每次传入不超过`UINT16_MAX`，返回实际接受字节数；不能无条件返回原长度。
432: - `sc_force`和`arm_lowputc`仍只能best-effort，不宣称IRQ关闭时可靠。可提供有界flush，例如等待不超过20 ms；禁止永久等待ACK。
433: - 避免console和独立syslog backend重复输出同一条日志。最终配置只能有一个主syslog路径。
434: 
435: ## 8. CP UART0双向桥设计
436: 
437: ### 8.1 唯一MB_UART0 owner
438: 
439: CP只调用一次`bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0)`。现有`ap_uart0_log_init()`扩展为统一bridge：
440: 
441: - 注册MB_UART RX callback，唤醒AP输出worker。
442: - 注册MB_UART TX callback，唤醒PC输入发送worker。
443: - 使用有界CP->AP TX ring，建议512或1024字节。
444: - worker根据`bk_mb_uart_write_ready()`处理部分写入，调用`bk_mb_uart_write()`，直到队列为空或peer RTS暂停。
445: - 暴露drop、partial write、MB_UART status、mode switch和last error统计。
446: 
447: 不得为RX和TX分别初始化两次MB_UART0，也不得让日志服务和console服务分别open channel。
448: 
449: ### 8.2 AP输出模式
450: 
451: 提供两个输出策略，但共享同一个MB_UART RX：
452: 
453: 1. `LOG`模式：保持当前按行添加`ap0: `、50 ms半行flush和有限重试，适合AP后台日志。
454: 2. `RAW_CONSOLE`模式：不添加前缀、不等待换行，收到后立即通过CP shell TX queue输出，保证`nsh>`、echo、退格和ANSI字节透明。
455: 
456: 进入AP交互console时切为RAW；退出后恢复LOG。模式切换前先flush旧的半行缓存，防止旧日志与prompt拼接。CP自身异步日志仍可能插入AP终端，第一版应在RAW模式下抑制非关键CP日志或明确串行化，至少不能从两个线程直接写物理UART0。
457: 
458: ### 8.3 UART0输入所有权
459: 
460: CP shell已拥有物理UART0 RX ISR和buffer，因此路由点放在`shell_task.c`读取UART字节之后、执行`handle_shell_input()`之前。状态固定为：
461: 
462: ```text
463: CP_CLI       所有输入由CP CLI处理
464: AP_CONSOLE   原始输入转发给MB_UART0，CP CLI不再解析
465: ```
466: 
467: 上电默认`CP_CLI`。只有满足以下条件才允许进入`AP_CONSOLE`：
468: 
469: - AP已发送Mailbox RESET abort通知并完成STATE/ACK链路探测。
470: - AP已发送IPC power-up和PWC boot ready。
471: - CP bridge确认MB_UART0可写。
472: 
473: CP CLI新增明确命令，例如`ap_console open`。命令handler只设置`SWITCH_TO_AP_PENDING`，不能立即修改owner：先等待当前命令响应和CP TX queue flush，抑制尾随`cp>`，原子清理`cmd_line_buf`、BK_REG/AT/escape解析状态并通过`SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_RESET`清物理UART RX残留，之后才进入AP_CONSOLE并打印一次切换提示。
474: 
475: AP_CONSOLE保留一个本地退出转义，建议使用行首`Ctrl-]`后跟`.`；解析器只在行首识别完整转义，其他字节原样转发。退出时进入`SWITCH_TO_CP_PENDING`，丢弃未完成转义、停止接收新AP输入、清理或明确丢弃尚未发送的bridge TX，flush AP RAW输出后再恢复CP parser和prompt。退出转义由CP消费，不发送给NSH。
476: 
477: 禁止把同一字节同时广播给CP CLI和AP NSH，否则两个shell会同时echo/执行。下载工具、ATE和bootloader阶段不进入该状态机，维持原UART0 owner。
478: 
479: ### 8.4 PC输入发送
480: 
481: 在AP_CONSOLE状态，CP shell现有UART RX路径读取到原始字节后：
482: 
483: 1. 先运行最小退出转义状态机。
484: 2. 非转义字节写入CP->AP bridge ring。
485: 3. bridge worker根据MB_UART write-ready发送；不得在UART ISR中调用可能触发Mailbox发送和复杂锁的接口。
486: 4. ring满时优先通过MB_UART RTS自然回压；物理UART0无硬件流控，仍可能在高速粘贴时丢字，必须计数并在退出RAW后报告。
487: 5. 可选的软件输入限速按115200估算，但不得sleep在UART ISR；只能由worker分批发送。
488: 
489: AP link down/reset时CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE，清理未发送输入并恢复CP_CLI，避免用户被锁死在无响应终端。为使该行为可实现，CP `mailbox_channel.c`必须新增peer RESET/physical timeout通知，IPC heartbeat/PWC recovery也要向bridge发布AP_DOWN事件；不能从`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`推断link状态。bridge通过统一event callback处理`AP_READY/AP_DOWN/PEER_RESET`，并在事件中只唤醒worker，不直接操作shell队列。
490: 
491: ### 8.5 CP原厂驱动最小加固
492: 
493: 在不改变线协议的前提下同步修复：
494: 
495: - `mb_uart_init()`第二个NULL检查应为`rx_xchg_buff`。
496: - DATA RX校验`cmd_buff`必须等于本端预期`rx_xchg_buff`，长度1..128。
497: - 所有command/response先清零保留字段。
498: - bridge必须正确处理`bk_mb_uart_write()`部分写和`bk_mb_uart_get_status()`。
499: - `mailbox_channel.c`向bridge暴露peer reset/timeout通知；收到AP reset时即使CP physical TX为空也必须发布事件，而不是只记fault后静默返回。
500: 
501: 原厂驱动在logical write成功时提前推进TX ring，远端`uart_tx_fail`时不会回滚。若不重写CP mb_uart状态机，CP输入可靠性仍低于AP改进实现。正式交付建议把CP TX也改为“ACK成功后推进ring”，但这会扩大原厂代码改动。实施可分两步：先完成兼容双向链路并测出失败路径，再将该加固作为进入压力验收前的必做项，而不是长期保留静默丢输入行为。
502: 
503: ## 9. 启动、ready和恢复时序
504: 
505: ### 9.1 CP时序
506: 
507: ```text
508: CP bootloader/download UART0保持原行为
509:   -> CP UART0 115200 8N1和shell初始化
510:   -> Mailbox V2 physical/channel初始化
511:   -> MB_UART0唯一bridge init，注册RX/TX callback
512:   -> 默认CP_CLI模式
513:   -> 启动AP
514:   -> 等待AP IPC power-up
515:   -> 等待AP PWC boot ready
516:   -> 允许用户执行ap_console open
517: ```
518: 
519: ### 9.2 AP时序
520: 
521: ```text
522: CPU1 reset
523:   -> MPU/vector/基础NuttX启动
524:   -> 注册有界early syslog，不访问UART1
525:   -> up_initialize调用arm_serialinit
526:   -> arm_serialinit在uart_register前初始化MBOX0 IRQ79和RX资源
527:   -> 初始化logical transport、ACK pool和MB_UART0 rings/SWAP/callback
528:   -> 创建Mailbox/UART RX/TX worker；允许其在调度器运行后启动
529:   -> 发送单向RESET abort通知，不等待RESET ACK
530:   -> 异步发送STATE(local_rts=0)，arm_serialinit不阻塞等待
531:   -> 注册/dev/console和/dev/ttyMB0
532:   -> board late在worker已运行后有界等待STATE transport ACK
533:   -> 发送IPC power-up并确认transport ACK
534:   -> 启动heartbeat和PWC worker
535:   -> 发送PWC boot ready
536:   -> 启动NSH
537: ```
538: 
539: `arm_serialinit()`运行在公共`up_initialize()`中，OS/driver服务可用，但不得依赖用户初始化线程已经运行，因此这里只安装全部资源并异步kick。STATE ACK的有界等待放到board late，此时worker和系统tick已明确运行。
540: 
541: ready门禁新增：MB_UART RX已能整包复制并调用NuttX worker，TX/STATE完成至少一次探测。日志输出失败不能无限阻塞heartbeat；有界失败后记录link状态，并按产品策略决定继续无console运行还是拒绝ready。比赛调试固件建议MB_UART失败时拒绝ready，避免出现“系统似乎启动但唯一console不可用”。
542: 
543: ### 9.3 suspend/resume和重启
544: 
545: 首版若未完整实现Mailbox PM，必须对相关deep sleep投票禁止进入，不能让CP关闭共享资源后AP仍认为link READY。
546: 
547: 实现PM后流程：
548: 
549: - suspend：停止新DATA，等待active有界完成，拉高RTS，发送STATE，保存统计并关闭IRQ route。
550: - resume：重配CPU1 FIFO/IRQ、清W1C错误、发送单向RESET abort通知、用STATE/ACK探测，再恢复DATA。
551: - AP重启：AP主动发送RESET abort通知；CP transport发布PEER_RESET/AP_DOWN事件，bridge将旧AP TX以失败完成并自动退出AP_CONSOLE。
552: - CP重启：AP ACK timeout进入ABORTING/DOWN，不继续写旧payload；CP恢复后重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测。

634: ## 12. 测试和验收矩阵
635: 
636: ### 12.1 构建和静态检查
637: 
638: - OpenVela AP `-Werror`构建通过；最终SMP `all-app.bin`完整构建通过。
639: - map中SWAP地址、大小、NOLOAD和AP heap边界正确；AP TX/RX指针分别固定为`0x2809fd00/0x2809fc00`。
640: - GPIO0/1没有UART1 pinmux，二进制无物理UART1 console初始化。
641: - CP覆盖副本与`bk_avdk_smp`目标文件`cmp -s`一致。
642: - 静态扫描不存在ISR内sleep、无界semaphore wait、printf或直接阻塞UART0输出。
643: 
644: ### 12.2 功能
645: 
646: | 用例 | 预期 |
647: | --- | --- |
648: | CP冷启动 | CP log和CP prompt正常，默认不劫持UART0输入 |
649: | AP启动 | 出现带`ap0:`的OpenVela日志，heartbeat无超时 |
650: | `ap_console open` | 切入RAW，出现`nsh>`且prompt无50 ms按行前缀改写 |
651: | NSH输入 | 字母、回车、退格、方向键、Ctrl-C均按TTY语义工作 |
652: | 退出转义 | 不传给AP，恢复CP prompt和LOG模式 |
653: | AP长输出 | 大于128字节正确分片、顺序一致、无覆盖 |
654: | PC高速粘贴 | RTS发生且系统不死锁；超出物理能力时drop计数可见 |
655: | `poll/read` | `/dev/console`和`/dev/ttyMB0`的POLLIN、blocking/nonblocking语义正确 |
656: 
657: ### 12.3 故障和并发
658: 
659: - 注入非法envelope地址、长度、SID、channel、payload地址、129字节长度和非零保留位，均拒绝且计数；有效command收到`COM_FAIL` ACK，不拖死CP physical channel。
660: - ACK FIFO满时不覆盖旧ACK；停止drain或受控恢复。
661: - 丢失DATA ACK后不原地改写in-flight slot，不出现无限重复字符。
662: - stale/wrong cmd/wrong sequence ACK不能释放当前事务。
663: - RX ring不足时整包拒绝，`uart_tx_fail=1`，不部分注入NSH。
664: - AP重启期间CP自动退出AP_CONSOLE；重启后旧输入和旧输出不重放。
665: - CP重启后AP进入DOWN并重新执行RESET abort和STATE/ACK探测，无永久`peer_rts=1`。
666: - 连续10 MiB AP输出、1 MiB双向随机字节和1小时交互期间，heartbeat、PWC和CP UART0不失效。
667: - UART压力下HW_CTRL/PWC优先于UART0，ready和heartbeat延迟有上界。
668:

670: 
671: ```text
672: CP boot...
673: ap0: OpenVela mailbox uart ready
674: cp> ap_console open
675: nsh> uname -a
676: ...
677: nsh>                         # 行首 Ctrl-] .

684: ## 13. 风险和明确决策
685: 
686: 1. **唯一物理UART复用风险**：UART0同时服务下载、CP shell、CP log和AP console。通过运行期显式owner切换解决，不在bootloader阶段透明桥接。
687: 2. **原厂协议无端到端可靠序号**：transport sequence只关联单次message，ACK丢失后无法判断对端是否已消费。正式策略优先避免重复输入，记录`tx_unknown`并reset，而不是盲目重发。
688: 3. **物理UART无硬件流控**：Mailbox RTS只能限制CP到AP交换，不能让CH340停止已经到达CP UART FIFO的数据。高速粘贴仍需有界CP ring和可见drop。
689: 4. **panic日志限制**：MB_UART依赖中断，不能冒充真正polling UART。验收只要求正常调度和可屏蔽短临界区下工作，不承诺hard-fault关中断后的完整日志。
690: 5. **SMP并发**：当前AP为单核时可用local IRQ lock；正式启用CPU2前，transport和ring必须切换为NuttX SMP-safe spinlock并明确CPU1 owner或跨核代理。
691: 6. **cache**：首版SWAP non-cacheable。任何启cache改动必须两端同时验证，不能只加一个DMB就宣称安全。
692: 7. **CP改动维护成本**：完整输入owner必须修改shell路径，而不是只改`driver.c`。这些文件必须纳入external覆盖和构建说明，否则下一次清理构建会丢失功能。

3:  ****************************************************************************/

18: 
19: #define MBOX_REG(n) (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
20: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG MBOX_REG(0x20)
21: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG MBOX_REG(0x21)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x22)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x23)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TID MBOX_REG(0x24)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_SID MBOX_REG(0x25)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0 MBOX_REG(0x26)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1 MBOX_REG(0x27)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x28)
29: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS MBOX_REG(0x18)
30: #define MBOX_CTRL MBOX_REG(2)
31: #define MBOX_INT_STATUS MBOX_REG(3)
32: 
33: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
34: static bool g_mbox_ready;
35: 
36: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
37: {
38:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
39: }
40: 
41: int bk7258_mbox_receive(bk7258_mbox_message_t *message)
42: {
43:   if (message == NULL || (bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) != 0)
44:     {
45:       return -EINVAL;
46:     }
47: 
48:   message->src_cpu = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0xfu;
49:   message->data[0] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
50:   message->data[1] = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
51:   return OK;
52: }
53: 
54: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
55: {
56:   /* TX uses the CPU1-owned channel 1 registers, while the destination FIFO
57:    * full state is reported by the destination channel (CPU0 is channel 0). */
58:   if (destination > 2 || data == NULL ||
59:       (getreg32(destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS : MBOX_CH1_STATUS) & 1u) != 0)
60:     {
61:       return -EAGAIN;
62:     }
63: 
64:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
65:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
66:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
67:   return OK;
68: }
69: 
70: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
71: {
72:   bk7258_mbox_message_t message;
73:   (void)irq;
74:   (void)context;
75:   (void)arg;
76: 
77:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
78:     {
79:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&message) != OK)
80:         {
81:           break;
82:         }
83:       if (g_callback != NULL)
84:         {
85:           g_callback(&message);
86:         }
87:     }
88:   return OK;
89: }
90: 
91: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
92: {
93:   g_callback = callback;
94: }

96: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
97: {
98:   int ret;
99: 
100:   g_mbox_ready = false;
101:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1: FIFO starts at 2 and has three entries. */
102:   /* Channel 1 owns FIFO entries 2..4.  The start and length fields live in
103:    * separate registers on mailbox v2. */
104:   putreg32(2u | (1u << 8), MBOX_CH1_CFG);
105:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
106:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
107:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
108:   if (ret < 0)
109:     {
110:       return ret;
111:     }
112:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
113:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
114:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
115:     {
116:       bk7258_mbox_message_t ignored;
117:       if (bk7258_mbox_receive(&ignored) != OK)
118:         {
119:           break;
120:         }
121:     }
122: 
123:   g_mbox_ready = true;
124:   return OK;
125: }

174:       memcpy(&g_uart_xchg[first], g_uart_tx, count - first);
175:     }
176: 
177:   channel->message.header = 0; /* MB_UART_SEND_DATA */
178:   channel->message.param1 = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)g_uart_xchg;
179:   channel->message.param2 = count;
180:   channel->message.param3 = 0; /* RTS deasserted, CRC disabled by Armino. */
181:   channel->pending = true;
182:   g_uart_inflight = count;

185: static int dispatch_locked(void)
186: {
187:   struct logical_channel *channel;
188:   uint32_t wire[2];
189:   clock_t now;
190:   unsigned int i;
191:   int ret;
192: 
193:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
194:   if (g_phy_busy && now - g_busy_since >= PHY_BUSY_TIMEOUT)
195:     {
196:       g_stats.ack_timeout++;
197:       g_phy_busy = false;
198:     }
199: 
200:   if (g_phy_busy)
201:     {
202:       return OK;
203:     }
204: 
205:   if (g_ack_wire[0] != 0)
206:     {
207:       ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, g_ack_wire);
208:       if (ret < 0)
209:         {
210:           if (ret == -EAGAIN)
211:             {
212:               g_stats.fifo_full++;
213:             }
214: 
215:           return ret;
216:         }
217: 
218:       g_ack_wire[0] = 0;
219:       g_stats.tx_count++;
220:     }
221: 
222:   uart_prepare();
223:   for (i = 0; i < sizeof(g_channel_ids); i++)
224:     {
225:       channel = &g_channels[i];
226:       if (!channel->pending)
227:         {
228:           continue;
229:         }
230: 
231:       g_active_channel = g_channel_ids[i];
232:       g_active_seq = ++g_tx_seq;
233:       channel->message.header &= 0xffu;
234:       channel->message.header |= (uint32_t)g_active_seq << 16;
235:       channel->message.header |= (uint32_t)g_active_channel << 24;
236:       wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&channel->message;
237:       wire[1] = sizeof(channel->message);
238:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
239:       ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
240:       if (ret < 0)
241:         {
242:           if (ret == -EAGAIN)
243:             {
244:               g_stats.fifo_full++;
245:             }
246: 
247:           return ret;
248:         }
249: 
250:       g_phy_busy = true;
251:       g_busy_since = now;
252:       g_stats.tx_count++;
253:       return OK;
254:     }
255: 
256:   return OK;
257: }

285: static int queue_message(uint8_t logical_channel, uint8_t command,
286:                          uint32_t p1, uint32_t p2, uint32_t p3)
287: {
288:   struct logical_channel *channel;
289:   irqstate_t flags;
290:   unsigned int index;
291:   int ret;
292: 
293:   if (!g_initialized)
294:     {

296:     }

298:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
299:   if (index >= sizeof(g_channel_ids))

312:   channel->message.header = command;
313:   channel->message.param1 = p1;
314:   channel->message.param2 = p2;

323: static bool valid_cp_message(const bk7258_mbox_message_t *wire,
324:                              uintptr_t *address)
325: {
326:   *address = wire->data[0];
327:   /* Armino's mbox0_adapter mailbox_buff is an array of 16-byte messages in
328:    * CP .bss and is only word-aligned; 32-byte alignment is reserved for the
329:    * separate exchange payload buffers. */
330:   return wire->src_cpu == 0 && wire->data[1] == sizeof(struct mb_message) &&
331:          (*address & 3u) == 0 && *address >= CP_RAM_START &&
332:          *address <= CP_RAM_END - sizeof(struct mb_message);
333: }

335: static void handle_ack(struct mb_message *message)
336: {
337:   uint8_t logical_channel = message->header >> 24;
338:   uint8_t sequence = message->header >> 16;
339:   bool uart_failed;
340:   unsigned int index;
341: 
342:   if ((message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_RESET << 12)) != 0)
343:     {
344:       g_stats.reset_count++;
345:       g_phy_busy = false;
346:       (void)dispatch_locked();
347:       return;
348:     }
349: 
350:   if (logical_channel != g_active_channel || sequence != g_active_seq)
351:     {
352:       /* An ACK from a timed-out transmission may arrive after the same
353:        * logical channel has already been retried with a new sequence. It is
354:        * stale and must not release the current in-flight transaction. */
355:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
356:       return;
357:     }
358: 
359:   index = channel_index(g_active_channel);
360:   if (index >= sizeof(g_channel_ids) || !g_channels[index].pending)
361:     {
362:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
363:       g_phy_busy = false;
364:       (void)dispatch_locked();
365:       return;
366:     }
367: 
368:   g_channels[index].pending = false;
369:   if (g_active_channel == MB_CHNL_UART0_TX)
370:     {
371:       uart_failed =
372:         (message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8)) != 0 ||
373:         (message->param1 & 2u) != 0;
374:       if (uart_failed)
375:         {
376:           g_stats.uart_tx_fail++;
377:           g_uart_inflight = 0;
378:           g_uart_retry_after = clock_systime_ticks() + TX_RETRY_INTERVAL;
379:         }
380:       else
381:         {
382:           g_uart_read = (g_uart_read + g_uart_inflight) % UART_TX_SIZE;
383:           g_uart_inflight = 0;
384:           g_uart_retry_after = 0;
385:           g_serial_kick = true;
386:         }
387: 
388:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
389:     }
390: 
391:   g_phy_busy = false;
392:   uart_prepare();
393:   (void)dispatch_locked();
394: }

396: static void mailbox_rx(const bk7258_mbox_message_t *wire)
397: {
398:   struct mb_message message;
399:   uintptr_t address;
400:   uint8_t control;
401:   uint8_t logical_channel;
402:   irqstate_t flags;
403: 
404:   if (!valid_cp_message(wire, &address))
405:     {
406:       g_stats.bad_envelope++;
407:       g_stats.last_bad_address = wire->data[0];
408:       g_stats.last_bad_length = wire->data[1];
409:       g_stats.last_bad_source = wire->src_cpu;
410:       return;
411:     }
412: 
413:   memcpy(&message, (const void *)address, sizeof(message));
414:   control = (message.header >> 12) & 0x0fu;
415:   logical_channel = message.header >> 24;
416:   g_stats.rx_count++;
417: 
418:   flags = up_irq_save();
419:   if ((control & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
420:     {
421:       handle_ack(&message);
422:       up_irq_restore(flags);
423:       return;
424:     }
425: 
426:   if ((logical_channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
427:     {
428:       g_stats.unsupported_channel++;
429:       g_stats.last_bad_channel = logical_channel;
430:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
431:     }
432:   else if (logical_channel != MB_CHNL_PWC_RX &&
433:            logical_channel != MB_CHNL_UART0_RX)
434:     {
435:       /* Match the vendor mailbox channel layer: a valid channel without a
436:        * registered receiver still gets a COM_FAIL transport ACK. Returning
437:        * without the ACK leaves CP's physical channel BUSY and blocks higher
438:        * priority PWC responses queued behind this message.
439:        */
440: 
441:       g_stats.unsupported_channel++;
442:       g_stats.last_bad_channel = logical_channel;
443:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
444:     }
445: 
446:   if (logical_channel == MB_CHNL_UART0_RX)
447:     {
448:       /* This port is output-only. Acknowledge Armino's state/data commands
449:        * with RTS deasserted without injecting CP CLI input into AP serial. */
450:       if ((message.header & 0xffu) != MB_UART_SEND_DATA &&
451:           (message.header & 0xffu) != MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
452:         {
453:           message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8;
454:         }
455: 
456:       message.param1 = 0; /* uart_rts=0, uart_tx_fail=0 */
457:       message.param2 = 0;
458:       message.param3 = 0;
459:     }
460: 
461:   if ((control & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
462:     {
463:       message.header |= (uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX << 12;
464:       memcpy((void *)address, &message, sizeof(message));
465:       memcpy(&g_ack_message, &message, sizeof(g_ack_message));
466:       g_ack_wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&g_ack_message;
467:       g_ack_wire[1] = sizeof(g_ack_message);
468:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
469:       if (bk7258_mbox_send(0, g_ack_wire) < 0)
470:         {
471:           g_stats.fifo_full++;
472:           nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
473:         }
474:       else
475:         {
476:           g_ack_wire[0] = 0;
477:           g_stats.tx_count++;
478:         }
479: 
480:       message.header &= ~((uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX << 12);
481:     }
482: 
483:   if (logical_channel == MB_CHNL_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
484:     {
485:       g_pwc_rx(&message);
486:     }
487: 
488:   up_irq_restore(flags);
489: }

636: int bk7258_mbox_uart_write(const uint8_t *data, uint16_t length)
637: {
638:   irqstate_t flags;
639:   uint16_t written = 0;
640: 
641:   if (data == NULL || length == 0)
642:     {
643:       return -EINVAL;
644:     }
645: 
646:   flags = up_irq_save();
647:   {
648:     uint16_t free_space;
649:     uint16_t first;
650: 
651:     if (g_uart_write >= g_uart_read)
652:       {
653:         free_space = UART_TX_SIZE - (g_uart_write - g_uart_read) - 1u;
654:       }
655:     else
656:       {
657:         free_space = g_uart_read - g_uart_write - 1u;
658:       }
659: 
660:     if (length < free_space)
661:       {
662:         written = length;
663:       }
664:     else
665:       {
666:         written = free_space;
667:       }
668: 
669:     first = UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart_write;
670:     if (first > written)
671:       {
672:         first = written;
673:       }
674: 
675:     memcpy(&g_uart_tx[g_uart_write], data, first);
676:     if (first < written)
677:       {
678:         memcpy(g_uart_tx, data + first, written - first);
679:       }
680: 
681:     g_uart_write = (g_uart_write + written) % UART_TX_SIZE;
682:     g_stats.uart_write_calls++;
683:     g_stats.uart_write_bytes += written;
684: 
685:     if (written < length)
686:       {
687:         g_stats.uart_drop += length - written;
688:         g_stats.uart_drop_events++;
689:       }
690:   }
691: 
692:   if (g_initialized)
693:     {
694:       uart_prepare();
695:       (void)dispatch_locked();
696:     }
697:   up_irq_restore(flags);
698:   if (g_initialized)
699:     {
700:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
701:     }
702:   return written == length ? OK : -ENOSPC;
703: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c
3:  *
4:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
5:  ****************************************************************************/
6: 
7: #include <nuttx/config.h>
8: 
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdbool.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/init.h>
13: 
14: #include "arm_internal.h"
15: #include "mpu.h"
16: #include "nvic.h"
17: 
18: #include "hardware/bk7258_memorymap.h"
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_psram.h"
20: 
21: #if defined(CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM) && \
22:     CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE != BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE
23: #  error "BK7258 OpenVela and app_ab PSRAM capacities differ"
24: #endif
25: 
26: int bk7258_syslog_initialize(void);
27: 
28: extern const uint8_t _eronly[];
29: extern uint8_t _sdata[];
30: extern uint8_t _edata[];
31: extern uint8_t _sbss[];
32: extern uint8_t _ebss[];
33: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_load[];
34: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_start[];
35: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_end[];
36: extern uint8_t __idle_stack_base[];
37: extern uint8_t __idle_stack_top[];
38: 
39: const uintptr_t g_idle_topstack = (uintptr_t)__idle_stack_top;
40: 
41: static const struct mpu_region_s g_bk7258_mpu_regions[] =
42: {
43:   {
44:     BK7258_AP_FLASH_BASE,
45:     BK7258_AP_FLASH_SIZE,
46:     MPU_RBAR_AP_RORO | MPU_RBAR_SH_NO,
47:     MPU_RLAR_WRITE_THROUGH
48:   },
49:   {
50:     BK7258_AP_RAM_BASE,
51:     BK7258_AP_RAM_SIZE,
52:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
53:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
54:   },
55: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
56:   {
57:     BK7258_PSRAM_BASE,
58:     BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE,
59:     /* Match the BK7258 vendor AP mapping.  The PSRAM controller's normal,
60:      * non-cacheable window is non-shareable on this interconnect.
61:      */
62: 
63:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_NO,
64:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
65:   },
66: #endif
67:   {
68:     0x40000000u,
69:     0x20000000u,
70:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
71:     MPU_RLAR_DEVICE
72:   },
73: };
74: 
75: static void __attribute__((used, noinline, noreturn,
76:                            target("general-regs-only")))
77: bk7258_start(void)
78: {
79:   const uint8_t *src;
80:   uint8_t *dest;
81: 
82:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
83:    * floating-point extension.
84:    */
85: 
86:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
87:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
88:   UP_DSB();
89:   UP_ISB();
90: 
91:   /* Match the current golden SPE SAU setup: the secure alias is retained,
92:    * while the 0x10000000 non-secure alias range is exposed as non-secure.
93:    */
94: 
95:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
96:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
97:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
98:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
99:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
100:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
101:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
102:   UP_DSB();
103:   UP_ISB();
104: 
105:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
106:     {
107:       *dest++ = *src++;
108:     }
109: 
110:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
111:     {
112:       *dest++ = 0;
113:     }
114: 
115:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
116:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
117:     {
118:       *dest++ = *src++;
119:     }
120: 
121:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
122:   UP_DSB();
123:   UP_ISB();
124: 
125:   /* Install the buffered AP log channel before normal NuttX startup. */
126:   (void)bk7258_syslog_initialize();
127: 
128: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
129:   mpu_reset();
130:   mpu_initialize(g_bk7258_mpu_regions,
131:                  sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions) /
132:                  sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions[0]),
133:                  false, true);
134: #endif
135: 
136: #ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
137:   arm_earlyserialinit();
138: #endif
139: 
140:   nx_start();
141:   for (; ; )
142:     {
143:     }
144: }
145: 
146: void __attribute__((naked, noreturn, section(".start_text"))) __start(void)
147: {
148:   __asm__ volatile
149:     (
150:       "cpsid i\n"
151:       "ldr r0, =__idle_stack_base\n"
152:       "msr msplim, r0\n"
153:       "b bk7258_start\n"
154:     );
155: }

<content>
1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 PWC worker and CPU1 ready handshake.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: #include <stdio.h>
9: 
10: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
11: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
12: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
13: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: 
16: #include "bk7258_psram.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
18: 
19: #define PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD 0x5u
20: #define PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD 0x7u
21: #define PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD 0x8u
22: #define PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD 0x9u
23: #define PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD 0xau
24: #define PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1 11u
25: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON 0u
26: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF 1u
27: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT 0u
28: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH 1u
29: #define PM_QUEUE_DEPTH 8u
30: #define PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS 500u
31: #define PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS 1000u
32: 
33: struct pwc_message
34: {
35:   uint32_t header;
36:   uint32_t param1;
37:   uint32_t param2;
38:   uint32_t param3;
39: };
40: 
41: static struct pwc_message g_queue[PM_QUEUE_DEPTH];
42: static volatile unsigned int g_head;
43: static volatile unsigned int g_tail;
44: static sem_t g_pwc_sem;
45: static sem_t g_worker_sem;
46: static sem_t g_psram_power_sem;
47: static volatile bool g_worker_ready;
48: static volatile bool g_ready_sent;
49: static volatile bool g_psram_power_waiting;
50: static volatile uint32_t g_psram_power_state;
51: 
52: static void psram_power_vote_rollback(void)
53: {
54:   int ret;
55: 
56:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
57:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
58:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF, 0);
59:   if (ret >= 0)
60:     {
61:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
62:     }
63: 
64:   if (ret < 0)
65:     {
66:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote rollback failed, error=%d\n", ret);
67:     }
68: }
69: 
70: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
71: {
72:   static uint32_t heartbeat_payload;
73: 
74:   (void)argc;
75:   (void)argv;
76:   for (;;)
77:     {
78:       nxsig_usleep(2000000);
79:       (void)bk7258_mbox_send_message(2, 0x10,
80:                                      (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&heartbeat_payload,
81:                                      sizeof(heartbeat_payload), 0);
82:     }
83:   return 0;
84: }
85: 
86: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
87: {
88:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
89:   struct pwc_message message;
90:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
91:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
92:     {
93:       return;
94:     }
95:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
96:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
97:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
98:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
99:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
100:   g_head = next;
101:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
102: }
103: 
104: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
105: {
106:   (void)argc;
107:   (void)argv;
108:   g_worker_ready = true;
109:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
110:   for (;;)
111:     {
112:       struct pwc_message message;
113:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
114:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
115:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
116:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
117:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
118:         {
119:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
120:             /* The unmodified AVDK SMP firmware returns the requested ON/OFF
121:              * state in param1. It does not expose the PSRAM driver result or
122:              * detected capacity, so AP validates its configured regions with
123:              * the non-destructive boundary probe before creating allocators.
124:              */
125: 
126:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
127:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
128:               {
129:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
130:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
131:               }
132:             break;
133: 
134: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
135:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
136:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
137:               {
138:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
139:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
140:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
141:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
142:               }
143:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
144:               {
145:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
146: 
147:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
148:               }
149:             break;
150: 
151:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
152:             bk7258_psram_dump();
153:             break;
154: 
155:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
156:             {
157:               int ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
158: 
159:               (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
160:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
161:                 ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
162:                            PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
163:             }
164:             break;
165: #endif
166: 
167:           default:
168:             break;
169:         }
170:     }
171:   return 0;
172: }
173: 
174: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
175: {
176:   int pid;
177:   int ret;
178: 
179:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
180:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
181:   nxsem_init(&g_psram_power_sem, 0, 0);
182:   g_head = 0;
183:   g_tail = 0;
184:   g_worker_ready = false;
185:   g_ready_sent = false;
186:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
187:   g_psram_power_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
188:   pid = bk7258_mailbox_init();
189:   if (pid < 0)
190:     {
191:       return pid;
192:     }
193:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
194:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
195:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
196:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
197:     {
198:       return -1;
199:     }
200: 
201:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
202:   if (ret < 0)
203:     {
204:       printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
205:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
206:       return ret;
207:     }
208:   printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport complete\n");
209: 
210:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
211:                      NULL) < 0)
212:     {
213:       return -1;
214:     }
215:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
216:   if (pid < 0)
217:     {
218:       return pid;
219:     }
220:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
221:       !g_worker_ready)
222:     {
223:       printf("PWC: worker start timeout\n");
224:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
225:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
226:     }
227:   printf("PWC: worker ready\n");
228: 
229:   /* CP boots CPU1 from its low-power worker and waits there for this ready
230:    * command. Send it before requesting PSRAM, whose vote is handled by that
231:    * same worker, otherwise the two cores deadlock waiting for each other.
232:    */
233: 
234:   g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD,
235:                                          1, 0, 0) == 0;
236:   if (!g_ready_sent)
237:     {
238:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready queue failed\n");
239:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
240:       return -EIO;
241:     }
242: 
243:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
244:   if (ret < 0)
245:     {
246:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
247:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
248:       return ret;
249:     }
250: 
251:   printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready acknowledged by CP transport\n");
252: 
253: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
254:   g_psram_power_waiting = true;
255:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
256:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
257:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON, 0);
258:   if (ret >= 0)
259:     {
260:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_psram_power_sem,
261:                          MSEC2TICK(PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS));
262:     }
263: 
264:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
265:   if (ret < 0 || g_psram_power_state != PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
266:     {
267:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power response failed, error=%d state=%lu\n",
268:              ret, (unsigned long)g_psram_power_state);
269:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
270:       psram_power_vote_rollback();
271: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
272:       return ret < 0 ? ret : -EIO;
273: #endif
274:     }
275:   else
276:     {
277:       /* printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote ON acknowledged\n"); */
278:       ret = bk7258_psram_initialize();
279:       if (ret < 0)
280:         {
281:           printf("PWC: PSRAM allocator initialization failed, error=%d\n",
282:                  ret);
283:           psram_power_vote_rollback();

7: /* g_bk7258_boot_vectors and _vectors (bk7258_vectors.c) are matched into
8:  * the .bk_boot_vectors / .ram_vectors output sections below purely by
9:  * input section name.  Nothing in the C code references either symbol
10:  * directly, so without this EXTERN() the linker never has a reason to
11:  * pull bk7258_vectors.o out of libarch.a in the first place: KEEP() only
12:  * protects sections that are already part of the link from
13:  * --gc-sections, it does not force extraction of an otherwise-unused
14:  * static archive member.  Without this, both output sections silently
15:  * come out empty (verified via nuttx.map) and the boot/runtime vector
16:  * tables are missing at runtime, not just failing the size ASSERT below.
17:  */
18: EXTERN(g_bk7258_boot_vectors)
19: EXTERN(_vectors)
20: 
21: MEMORY
22: {
23:   FLASH (rx)  : ORIGIN = 0x02150000, LENGTH = 0x00110000
24:   RAM   (rwx) : ORIGIN = 0x28010000, LENGTH = 0x00054000
25:   PSRAM_SECTION (rw) : ORIGIN = 0x60a00000, LENGTH = 0x00600000
26: }
27: 
28: __ap_ram_start = ORIGIN(RAM);
29: __ap_ram_end = ORIGIN(RAM) + LENGTH(RAM);
30: 
31: SECTIONS
32: {
33:   .bk_boot_vectors ORIGIN(FLASH) : ALIGN(512)
34:   {
35:     KEEP(*(.bk_boot_vectors))
36:   } > FLASH
37: 
38:   .gnu.sgstubs : ALIGN(32)
39:   {
40:     KEEP(*(.gnu.sgstubs*))
41:   } > FLASH
42: 
43:   .text : ALIGN(4)
44:   {
45:     _stext = .;
46:     KEEP(*(.start_text))
47:     *(.text .text.*)
48:     *(.rodata .rodata.*)
49:     KEEP(*(.init))
50:     KEEP(*(.fini))
51:     _etext = .;
52:   } > FLASH
53: 
54:   .init_array : ALIGN(4)
55:   {
56:     __init_array_start = .;
57:     KEEP(*(SORT_BY_INIT_PRIORITY(.init_array.*)))
58:     KEEP(*(.init_array))
59:     __init_array_end = .;
60:   } > FLASH
61: 
62:   .ARM.extab : ALIGN(4)
63:   {
64:     *(.ARM.extab* .gnu.linkonce.armextab.*)
65:   } > FLASH
66: 
67:   __exidx_start = .;
68:   .ARM.exidx : ALIGN(4)
69:   {
70:     *(.ARM.exidx* .gnu.linkonce.armexidx.*)
71:   } > FLASH
72:   __exidx_end = .;
73: 
74:   .data : ALIGN(8)
75:   {
76:     _sdata = .;
77:     *(.data .data.* .sdata .sdata.*)
78:     _edata = .;
79:   } > RAM AT > FLASH
80:   _eronly = LOADADDR(.data);

82:   .ram_vectors : ALIGN(512)
83:   {
84:     __ram_vectors_start = .;
85:     KEEP(*(.ram_vectors))
86:     __ram_vectors_end = .;
87:   } > RAM AT > FLASH

90:   .bss (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
91:   {
92:     _sbss = .;
93:     *(.bss .bss.* .sbss .sbss.*)
94:     *(COMMON)
95:     _ebss = .;
96:   } > RAM
97: 
98:   .noinit (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
99:   {
100:     *(.noinit .noinit.*)
101:   } > RAM
102: 
103:   .idle_stack (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
104:   {

114:     __ap_psram_data_end = .;
115:   } > PSRAM_SECTION AT > FLASH

117:   .psram.bss (NOLOAD) : ALIGN(8)
118:   {
119:     __ap_psram_bss_start = .;
120:     *(.psram.bss .psram.bss.*)
121:     __ap_psram_bss_end = .;
122:   } > PSRAM_SECTION
123:

14: #define BK7258_AP_FLASH_SIZE       0x00110000u
15:

21: #define BK7258_AON_GPIO_BASE       0x44000400u
22: #define BK7258_UART1_BASE          0x45830000u
23: #define BK7258_MBOX0_BASE          0x41000000u
24: #define BK7258_QSPI0_BASE          0x46040000u
25: 
26: /* QSPI1 controller (SOC_QSPI1_REG_BASE,
27:  * bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/soc/bk7258_ap/reg_base.h:118).  Used for GC9D01
28:  * LCD panel access on this board: per the board schematic
29:  * (AIDK_AI玩具开发板_原理图.pdf sheet 2/6 main chip pin table + sheet 5/6
30:  * CN5 single-screen connector), the panel's LCD_QSPI_CLK/CS/D0/D1 net
31:  * labels are wired to chip pins 35/34/33/32, i.e. P2/P3/P4/P5
32:  * (GPIO2/GPIO3/GPIO4/GPIO5).  The chip's pinmux table
33:  * (bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h GPIO_DEV_MAP)
34:  * shows those exact 4 GPIOs have QSPI1_CLK/QSPI1_CSN/QSPI1_IO0/QSPI1_IO1
35:  * at function-select index 6 -- QSPI1 has no other selectable pin group,
36:  * these 4 lines are hard-wired inside the SoC to this specific one, they
37:  * cannot be split across different GPIOs. Note the schematic's literal
38:  * net names ("D0/D1" etc.) do NOT match the SoC's real hardware role for
39:  * these pins (CLK/CSN, not data lines) -- PCB net labels are the
40:  * designer's arbitrary connector-pin numbering convention, not a
41:  * statement about which SoC peripheral function is multiplexed onto that
42:  * pad; the real role is only knowable from gpio_map.h.  This driver was
43:  * originally (incorrectly) built against QSPI0 (GPIO22/23/24/25,
44:  * function index 3) because bk_avdk_smp's generic
45:  * projects/spi_lcd_example reference config uses qspi_id=0 -- but that
46:  * reference project's own schematic (not available in this repo) wires
47:  * its LCD to a different GPIO group than this board's CN5 connector.
48:  * See bk7258_qspi.c file header for the full corrected-vs-original
49:  * comparison. */
50: #define BK7258_QSPI1_BASE          0x46060000u
51: 
52: /* Hardware I2C1 controller (SOC_I2C1_REG_BASE,
53:  * bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:92).  Used for GC2145
54:  * register access on this board: per the board schematic
55:  * (AIDK_AI玩具开发板_原理图.pdf sheet 4/6 "DVP/SENSOR/NAND/MOTOR/KEY"),
56:  * GC2145's SCL/SDA are wired to IIC1_SCL/IIC1_SDA (with 4.7K pull-ups to
57:  * VDDGPIO), which the chip's GPIO pinmux table
58:  * (bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h
59:  * GPIO_I2C1_MAP_TABLE) routes to GPIO42/GPIO43 (the second of two
60:  * selectable I2C1 pin groups; the other group, GPIO0/GPIO1, is what this
61:  * driver's previous software-simulated-I2C implementation incorrectly
62:  * assumed and is actually wired to UART1_TXD/UART1_RXD on this board --
63:  * see bk7258_i2c1.c file header for the full corrected-vs-original
64:  * comparison). */
65: #define BK7258_I2C1_BASE           0x45860000u
66: 
67: /* PSRAM data region.  YUV_BUF hardware uses a fixed base address here
68:  * (SOC_PSRAM_DATA_BASE, ap/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:43) as its line
69:  * buffer in YUV direct-capture mode (yuv_buf_hal_set_yuv_mode_config()
70:  * hard-codes em_base_addr/emr_base_addr to this address, not an
71:  * application-supplied one).  Size: the actual PSRAM chip on this board
72:  * has been observed at boot to be 16MB (serial log:
73:  * "psram type(16MB) not match CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY 0X00800000"), so
74:  * 0x01000000 (16MB) is used here rather than the chip-family maximum
75:  * SOC_PSRAM_DATA_SIZE (0x4000000, 64MB) -- both are valid MPU region
76:  * sizes (power-of-two, naturally aligned to SOC_PSRAM_DATA_BASE), 16MB
77:  * matches the verified real hardware capacity.
78:  */
79: #define BK7258_PSRAM_BASE          0x60000000u
80: #define BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE          0x01000000u
81: 
82: #define BK7258_NVIC_BASE           0xe000e100u
83: #define BK7258_SCB_BASE            0xe000ed00u
84: #define BK7258_SAU_BASE            0xe000edd0u
85: 
86: #endif

1: # Beken AVDK 覆盖与构建基线
2: 
3: 本目录保存 BK7258 OpenVela 最终固件构建所需的 Beken AVDK 覆盖文件，并作为
4: 多人协作时 `bk_avdk_smp` 修改的同步记录。不要只修改工作区中的
5: `~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp`；可复现修改必须同时更新本目录及本文档。
6: 
7: ## 1. 当前覆盖文件
8: 
9: | 比赛仓权威副本 | `bk_avdk_smp` 目标文件 | 作用 |
10: | --- | --- | --- |
11: | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` | CP 启动时初始化 PSRAM，并提供 AP 日志转发 |
12: | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | `projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv` | BK7258 640 KiB Share SRAM 和 16 MiB PSRAM 布局 |
13: 
14: `driver.c`还包含 CP shell 队列串行化、AP 日志按行缓存、`ap0:`来源前缀、
15: 50 ms 半行刷新和队列提交失败有限重试。
16: 
17: `ram_regions.csv`采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`、`lvgl/freetype_font` 的 16 MiB
18: 七区域布局：
19: 
20: ```text
21: 0x60000000..0x60700000  四个媒体 slab，共 7 MiB
22: 0x60700000..0x60720000  CP PSRAM heap，128 KiB
23: 0x60720000..0x60a00000  AP PSRAM heap，2.875 MiB
24: 0x60a00000..0x61000000  AP PSRAM section，6 MiB
25: ```
26: 
27: ## 2. 同步到 SMP 工作树
28: 
29: 从工作区根目录执行：
30: 
31: ```bash
32: cp \
33:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c \
34:   bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
35: 
36: cp \
37:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv \
38:   bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
39: ```
40: 
41: 同步后必须逐字节检查：
42: 
43: ```bash
44: cmp -s \
45:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c \
46:   bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
47: 
48: cmp -s \
49:   contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv \
50:   bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
51: ```
52: 
53: 两个`cmp`都必须返回0。
54: 
55: ## 3. 正确构建链条
56: 
57: 最终固件链条固定为：
58: 
59: ```text
60: OpenVela nuttx.bin
61:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
62:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
63:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
64:   -> package/all-app.bin
65: 
66: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
67:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
68: ```
69: 
70: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
71: 
72: - `ram_regions.csv`
73: - AP/CP `config`
74: - Kconfig 默认值
75: - 分区生成脚本
76: - SoC 链接脚本
77: 
78: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
79: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
80: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
81: 
82: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
83: 
84: ```bash
85: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
86: ./build.sh \
87:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
88:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
89: 
90: cp \
91:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
92:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
93: ```
94: 
95: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
96: 
97: ```bash
98: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
99: make -C projects/app_ab clean
100: 
101: podman run --rm \
102:   --userns=keep-id \
103:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
104:   -w /armino \
105:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
106:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
107:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
108:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
109: ```
110: 
111: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
112: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。
113: 
114: ## 4. 构建验收
115: 
116: 以下文件必须都反映同一份 16 MiB 布局：
117: 
118: ```text
119: projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
120: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h
121: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
122: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
123: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/bk7258/bk7258_out.ld
124: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_out.ld
125: ```
126: 
127: 关键值应为：
128: 
129: ```text
130: CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY          0x01000000
131: CP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60700000 + 0x00020000
132: AP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60720000 + 0x002e0000
133: AP_PSRAM_SECTION              0x60a00000 + 0x00600000
134: PSRAM 最终边界                0x61000000
135: ```
136: 
137: 外部 AP 输入和最终打包输入必须完全一致：
138: 
139: ```bash
140: sha256sum \
141:   ~/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
142:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
143:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
144: 
145: cmp -s \
146:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
147:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
148: ```
149: 
150: 检查最终产物：
151: 
152: ```text
153: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
154: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
155: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
156: ```
157: 
158: `build_summary.txt`中的 AP 内存统计来自 Armino AP 占位镜像，只用于检查生成的
159: 内存区域边界；它不代表最终打包的 OpenVela AP 静态占用。OpenVela AP 的静态
160: 内存应以 `nuttx.map`或`System.map`为准。
161: 
162: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
163: 
164: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
165: 
166: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
167: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
168: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
169: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
170: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
171: - 当前SMP协议兼容的`0x7/0x8/0x9/0xa`PWC处理和PSRAM_REQUIRED ready门禁。
172: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
173: 
174: 当前CP协议不通过`0xc`或其他命令暴露PSRAM initialized、device ID和actual capacity。
175: `0x7`响应只回显ON/OFF状态，不能单独证明PHY初始化成功或器件为16 MiB。因此当前
176: alias probe是临时运行时门禁，不能替代CP status协议扩展和整颗器件实板测试。

47: #define AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE 256
48: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX 3
49: #define AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS  10
50: #define AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS  50
51: 
52: static beken_semaphore_t s_ap_uart0_log_sem;
53: static beken_thread_t s_ap_uart0_log_thread;
54: static volatile uint32_t s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail;

56: static void ap_uart0_log_output(const uint8_t *line, u16 length)
57: {
58: 	static const uint8_t prefix[] = "ap0: ";
59: 	uint8_t output[sizeof(prefix) - 1 + AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
60: 	u16 output_length;
61: 	u8 retry;
62: 
63: 	memcpy(output, prefix, sizeof(prefix) - 1);
64: 	memcpy(output + sizeof(prefix) - 1, line, length);
65: 	output_length = sizeof(prefix) - 1 + length;
66: 
67: 	for (retry = 0; retry < AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MAX; retry++)
68: 	{
69: 		if (shell_log_raw_data(output, output_length))
70: 		{
71: 			return;
72: 		}
73: 
74: 		rtos_delay_milliseconds(AP_UART0_LOG_RETRY_MS);
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
78: }
79: 
80: static void ap_uart0_log_rx(void *param)
81: {
82: 	(void)param;
83: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
84: }
85: 
86: static void ap_uart0_log_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
87: {
88: 	uint8_t input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
89: 	uint8_t line[AP_UART0_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
90: 	u16 line_length = 0;
91: 
92: 	(void)arg;
93: 	for (;;)
94: 	{
95: 		u16 input_length;
96: 		u16 index;
97: 		bk_err_t ret;
98: 
99: 		ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem,
100: 						 line_length ? AP_UART0_LOG_FLUSH_MS : BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
101: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr)
102: 		{
103: 			ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
104: 			line_length = 0;
105: 			continue;
106: 		}
107: 
108: 		do
109: 		{
110: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
111: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
112: 			{
113: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
114: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
115: 				{
116: 					ap_uart0_log_output(line, line_length);
117: 					line_length = 0;
118: 				}
119: 			}
120: 		} while (input_length != 0);
121: 	}
122: }
123: 
124: static bk_err_t ap_uart0_log_init(void)
125: {
126: 	bk_err_t ret;
127: 
128: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, 1);
129: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
130: 	{
131: 		return ret;
132: 	}
133: 
134: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread,
135: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
136: 					 "ap_uart0_log", ap_uart0_log_task, 2048, NULL);
137: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
138: 	{
139: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
140: 		return ret;
141: 	}
142: 
143: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
144: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
145: 	{
146: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
147: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
148: 		return ret;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL);
152: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
153: 	{
154: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
155: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
156: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
157: 		return ret;
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	/* Drain data that may have arrived between channel open and callback
161: 	 * registration. The binary semaphore intentionally coalesces wakeups. */
162: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
163: 	return BK_OK;
164: }

179: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
180: {
181: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
182: 
183: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
184: 
185: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
186: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
187: 
188: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
189: 	{
190: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
191: 	}
192: 	else
193: 	{
194: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
195: 	}
196: 
197: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
198: 
199: 	if((uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL) || (uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0))
200: 	{
201: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
202: 	}
203: 
204: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
205: 	{
206: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
207: 		tx_fail = 1;
208: 		
209: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
213: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 	#endif
215: 
216: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
217: 
218: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
219: 
220: 	if(uart_cmd->crc8 != cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len))
221: 	{
222: 		chnl_cb->status_parity = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
223: 		tx_fail = 1;
224: 		
225: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
226: 	}
227: 
228: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
229: 	{
230: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
231: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
232: 	}
233: 	else
234: 	{
235: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
236: 
237: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
238: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
239: 
240: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
241: 		{
242: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
243: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
244: 		}
245: 		else
246: 		{
247: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
248: 
249: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
250: 			{
251: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
252: 			}
253: 
254: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
259: 
260: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
261: 	{
262: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
263: 	}
264: 
265: rx_isr_data_xit:
266: 	
267: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
268: 	{
269: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
273: 
274: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
275: 
276: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
277: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
278: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
279: 	 */
280: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
281: 
282: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
283: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
284: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
285: 
286: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
287: 	{
288: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
289: 		{
290: 			/* trigger send! */
291: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
292: 		}
293: 	}
294: 	
295: 	return;
296: }

298: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
299: {
300: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;

306: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!

309:

311: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 0;

326: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
327: {
328: 	/* clear here, because rts state will be passed in response data! */
329: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
330: 	
331: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
332: 	{
333: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
334: 	}
335: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
336: 	{
337: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
338: 	}
339: 	else
340: 	{
341: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
342: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
343: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
344: 		 */
345: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
346: 
347: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
348: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
349: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
350: 	}
351: 	
352: 	return;
353: }

355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

427: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
428: {
429: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
430: 
431: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
432: 		return BK_OK;
433: 
434: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
435: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
436: 
437: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
438: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
439: 
440: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
441: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
442: 	{
443: 		return BK_FAIL;
444: 	}
445: 
446: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
447: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
448: 	{
449: 		return ret_code;
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
453: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
454: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
455: 
456: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
457: 
458: 	return BK_OK;

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
541: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
543: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
544: 
545: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
546: 
547: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;
553: }

555: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data_trigger(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)

573: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)

575: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */

628: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
629: {
630: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
631: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
632: 	
633: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
634: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
635: 
636: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
637: 	{
638: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
643: 	}
644: 
645: 	wr_len = data_len;
646: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
647: 		wr_len = rem_len;
648: 
649: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
650: 	{
651: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
652: 	}
653: 	else
654: 	{
655: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
656: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
657: 
658: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
659: 		{
660: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
661: 		}
662: 		else
663: 		{
664: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
665: 
666: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
671: 
672: 	/* trigger send! */
673: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
674: 
675: 	return wr_len;
676: }

678: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
679: {
680: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
681: 
682: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
683: 		return 0;
684: 
685: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
686: 
687: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
688: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
689: 
690: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
691: 	{
692: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
693: 	}
694: 	else
695: 	{
696: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
700: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
701: 		rd_len = buf_len;
702: 
703: 	if(rd_len == 0)
704: 	{
705: 		return 0;
706: 	}
707: 
708: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
709: 	{
710: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
711: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
712: 	}
713: 	else
714: 	{
715: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
716: 
717: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
718: 		{
719: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
720: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
721: 		}
722: 		else
723: 		{
724: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
725: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
726: 			{
727: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
728: 			}
729: 
730: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
731: 		}
732: 	}
733: 
734: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
735: 
736: 	/* rts assert...... */
737: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
738: 	{
739: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
740: 		{
741: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
742: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
743: 		}
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	return rd_len;
747: 
748: }
